oracle-l5r-10680: Enslaved Djinn (Follower, Gates of Chaos): "After this Follower enters play, search your discard pile, then deck, for another Enslaved Djinn. Show it. Put it into your hand." The ordered search it needs now exists (Mendon's R4 ruling: SearchSpec.Ordered, DeckSearch.cs -- the searcher must take a qualifying card from the FIRST place that holds one, the deck is not searched, shown or shuffled otherwise, and a searched deck is always reshuffled). What is left is only the wiring of the card itself: a SearchSpec of [SearchDeck.FateDiscard, SearchDeck.Fate] with the criteria Titles ["Enslaved Djinn"] and SearchEffect.ToHand, and an own-enters-play Reaction (entryReaction window) that begins it (BeginSearch). Not wired in this task (it is outside the R4 rulings); it no longer needs any primitive.
oracle-l5r-10112: Celestial Sword of the Dragon - exp: the ordered search (discard pile, then deck) now exists (R4 ordered-search ruling, SearchSpec.Ordered), but the card still needs (a) a search effect that puts a Ring INTO PLAY or into the hand at the searcher's choice (SearchEffect has only ToHand, ToHandThenDiscard, AttachRegion, RecruitUnbowed, PutOnTopAfterShuffle, RecruitPersonality, PutIntoPlay for a Personality and ToProvinceFaceUp -- a Ring entering play must go through the Ring entry path with the Enlightenment exclusion mark 'ee-e:no-enlightenment' that Togashi's Guidance already sets), (b) 'while it remains in play, it does not count towards an Enlightenment Victory' for a Ring put into play by the search (the same mark), and (c) its other three lines (Dragon Clan attach restriction, +1F per Dragon Clan Personality, gain 2 Honor on entering play), which are buildable now.
oracle-l5r-533: Asako Chukage (Forgotten Legacy printing): "search your discard pile, then hand, then deck, for a Ring of Water. Put it into play or in your hand" -- the ordered search across places now exists (R4 ordered-search ruling) but the HAND is not a searchable place (SearchDeck has Dynasty, Fate, FateDiscard and DynastyDiscard; a hand card would be a public-to-the-searcher list like a discard pile that is never shuffled and is left by changing zone), and the Ring-into-play effect with the Enlightenment exclusion is missing (see oracle-l5r-10112).
